title: 第3章 新人Tree登场
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下午三点四十。

LPL官方微博更新了首发名单。

【LGD今日首发变更：中单位由Tree替换GodV登场。】

消息发出去不到十分钟，评论区直接炸了。

“？？？？？”

“韦神呢？”

“开始摆烂了是吧？”

“1-8以后终于疯了？”

抗压吧同步开帖。

《LGD首发更换，GodV替补，Tree登场》

下面回复疯狂刷新。

“Tree是谁？”

“查了一下，LSPL替补。”

“坏了，LGD真寄了。”

“死马当活马医了属于是。”

“笑死，银河战舰打成这样，现在开始抽卡了。”

“别尬黑，说不定是下一个Faker。”

“你家Faker在LDL当替补？”

“怎么有人叫树的啊，hello树先生？这人ID听着就是菜逼。”

帖子下面一片乐观气氛，LGD已经没有粉丝了，粉丝们转职去当乐观家族了。

现在观众看LGD比赛，已经不是看强队翻盘了，而是看乐子。

尤其春季赛打到现在，所谓银河战舰基本已经变成整个LPL最大的笑话。

而VG那边，反应也差不多。

VG休息室里，教练组刚拿到LGD首发名单时，几个人愣了一下。

“换人了？”

“GodV不上？”

Easyhoon抬头看了一眼名单。

Tree。

完全没听过。

VG教练皱了皱眉。

“新人？”

旁边分析师翻了半天资料。

“韩服分挺高。”

“以前LSPL待过。”

“训练赛消息不多。”

然后就没了。

这种选手在职业圈太常见了。

每年都有一大批韩服高分新人冒出来，然后又悄无声息消失。

真正能打出来的，没几个。

VG休息室里没人认真讨论Tree。

因为没必要。

LGD的问题从来不是中单一个位置，而且现在这种时候突然换新人，通常意味着一件事，队伍已经没招了。

Easyhoon重新低下头，继续看录像在：“正常打就行。”

虹桥天地演艺中心。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

3:40 p.m.

The LPL official Weibo updated the starting list.

[LGD’s first change today: the middle unit is replaced by GodV by Tree.】

Less than ten minutes after the message was posted, the comment section exploded.

"????"

"Where's Wei Shen?"

"It's starting to get messy, isn't it?"

"Finally went crazy after 1-8?"

The anti-stress bar opens posts simultaneously.

"LGD's starting lineup is changed, GodV is substituted, and Tree appears"

The replies below are refreshing like crazy.

"Who is Tree?"

"Checked, LSPL substitute."

"It's broken, LGD really sent it."

"It's a good idea to treat a dead horse as a living horse."

"It's so funny, the battleship of the Galaxy is like this, now the cards are drawn."

"Don't be embarrassed, he might be the next Faker."

"Your Faker is a substitute in LDL?"

"Why is there someone called Shu, hello Mr. Shu? This guy's ID sounds like a bad guy."

There is an optimistic atmosphere below the post. LGD has no fans anymore, and the fans have switched jobs to become an optimistic family.

Nowadays, when viewers watch LGD games, they are no longer watching a strong team comeback, but watching for fun.

Especially since the Spring Split, the so-called Galaxy Battleship has basically become the biggest joke in the entire LPL.

As for VG, the reaction was similar.

In the VG lounge, when the coaching staff first received the LGD starting list, several people were stunned for a moment.

"Replacement?"

"GodV can't go up?"

Easyhoon looked up at the list.

Tree.

Never heard of it at all.

Coach VG frowned.

"Newcomer?"

The analyst next to me flipped through the information for a long time.

"The Korean server score is pretty high."

"Been at LSPL before."

“There isn’t much news about the training matches.”

Then it was gone.

This kind of player is too common in the professional circle.

Every year, a large number of newcomers with high scores in the Korean server appear, and then disappear quietly.

There are only a few that can really be beaten.

No one in the VG lounge seriously discussed Tree.

Because it's not necessary.

LGD's problem has never been the mid lane position, and a sudden change of players at this time usually means one thing: the team has run out of recruits.

Easyhoon lowered his head again and continued watching the video: "Just fight normally."

Hongqiao Tiandi Performing Arts Center.
